name: Nether Earth: enemy
summary: The computer's side: the enemy commander, its robot builds and orders, and the nuclear blast.

entries.name: EnemyCommander
entries.summary: once a game turn the computer looks at one of its 24 robot slots: builds a robot in a free one or re-thinks a robot's order

entries.name: NuclearFlash
entries.summary: The nuclear blast's flash: the view's paper flickers through random colours with a fading rumble

entries.name: NuclearRumble
entries.summary: One burst of the blast's noise: B samples of ROM bytes to the speaker, C the delay between
